name: feature-flow
description: Capture ideas and converge feature plans into agent-ready GitHub issue bundles.

interface.shortDescription: Capture ideas and plan complete feature bundles.
interface.longDescription: Feature Flow provides separate Idea and Plan skills. Idea records durable GitHub Ideas; Plan converges Feature Specs, implementation issues, relationships, and exact workflow metadata while delegating GitHub transport to GitStack.
defaultPrompt: Use $idea to capture this proposal as a durable Idea.
Use $plan to turn this Idea into an agent-ready feature bundle.
Preview the Feature Flow publication without writing to GitHub.
